title: How Is a Rainbow Made? 🌈
description:
How is a rainbow made? Gizmo the robot finds out! 🌈🤖
A fun science Short for kids ages 4–8 from Gizmo Explains.

Sunlight is made of many colors. When it shines through raindrops, the colors spread out into a rainbow!

title: How Does Weather Work? 5 Weather Wonders for Kids
description:
Join Gizmo the robot for a 5-minute science adventure! I love asking, how does that work? Today we're going to find out how weather works. 🤖
Made for curious kids ages 4–8: guess-what clues, move-along fun, and a recap at the end.

What we learn today:
• Rain falls from heavy clouds.
• Rainbows need sun and rain.
• Lightning flashes, then thunder booms.
• Snow is frozen ice crystals.
• And wind is moving air!
